Preindustrial rainfall direction in p6 prose contradicts +18% in abstract, Figure 3 control-minus-PI and later discussion
WRF outer domain is 36 km in methods but 20 km in discussion
Text gives flood loss as $3.8 million, whereas PDNA reports damage/loss approximately $3.8 billion
Model omits artificial reservoirs and dam operations; inferred storage can exceed physical capacity
Reservoir equation uses calibrated constant evacuation eta and shape alpha; not an operational dam policy
Unphysical storage overflow does not demonstrate that all flood mitigation strategies were infeasible
Pre-FRL fitted storage correlation is not independent observed flood-peak validation
One-event pseudo-global-warming sensitivity does not establish changing event probabilities
32-model CMIP5 mean PGW deltas used without per-model outcome uncertainty
Control-period hydro spin-up used before perturbed weather runs; antecedent conditions lack scenario-consistent sensitivity
Alpha=1-beta scales net flows while claimed seepage proportional to storage is not explicitly modeled as function of S
No head-dependent generation, turbines, spillways, irrigation or environmental flow trade-offs
Figure 3 rain comparison 4 km WRF versus 0.25-degree merged product intentionally not regridded for quantitative validation
Domain river discharge map has no independent basinwise stream-gauge skill verification
Reservoir pseudo-capacity, inflow, downstream flooding and damage have different units and causal endpoints
Four- and six-reservoir averages shift ordering; two anomalous reservoirs matter
Figure 7 caption says storage rates but y-axis shows stored volume billion m3
Figure 5b/c plot different ratios in log scale; not all panels are absolute discharge maps
p6 described PI as drier despite PI generally wetter in the rest of paper
Claim southern Kerala would almost certainly flood under RCP8.5 not independently backed by inundation/exposure model
Aggregated reservoir inflow within basin may double count cascaded upstream/downstream water; requires topology
Seven highlighted dams, six calibrated storage sites and 62 modelling reservoir points are distinct denominators
North/mid/south basin group means are not accompanied by uncertainty intervals
Storage above nominal maximum cannot be actual reservoir storage after dynamic gate operation
India-WRIS reference data, alpha and eta fitted values not published within PDF
RCP8.5 2075–2100 delta is not a Kerala 2040 forecast or matched policy year
Moisture flux q and u decomposition lacks ensemble uncertainty or storm-track alternatives
Identical Mishra et al. 2018 references listed twice as 2018a and 2018b
CC BY 4.0 paper but original hydrology models, data vintages and scripts are not fully archived in PDF
No probability or return-period shift directly estimated across climate states
0.25-degree rainfall observational product and 4km/125m modelling have unresolved scale and terrain bias
